title: Nano Banana Pro gets 4K output
summary:
Nano Banana Pro gained 4K output while chat compatibility, error reporting, and balance checks got less brittle.

Nano Banana Pro now supports 1K, 2K, and 4K output based on requested dimensions, with dimensions mapped to the closest supported aspect ratio. Its default side length also increased from 1024 to 2048 pixels.

The chat API now accepts content-part arrays in more message roles, along with document file parts, Anthropic cache controls, and provider-specific content types. Streaming errors preserve upstream HTTP statuses, and Azure OpenAI requests translate `max_tokens` for newer models.

Enter now tracks recent meter balances locally and updates them after billable requests, reducing balance-check calls to Polar and the chance of requests encountering its API rate limits.

highlights.title: Nano Banana Pro in 4K
highlights.text: Request up to 4K output from `nanobanana-pro`. Its default side length is now 2048 pixels, up from 1024. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-pro).
